categories.label: Bib shorts
categories.description: Men's or unisex bib shorts (not shorts without straps, not tights).

categories.label: Short-sleeve jerseys
categories.description: Men's or unisex short-sleeve road jerseys.

categories.label: Long-sleeve & thermal jerseys
categories.description: Men's or unisex long-sleeve or thermal jerseys (not jackets).

categories.label: Winter & rain jackets
categories.description: Men's or unisex insulated, winter or waterproof cycling jackets (not wind shells or gilets).

categories.label: Gilets & vests
categories.description: Men's or unisex wind or insulated gilets/vests.

categories.label: Bib tights
categories.description: Men's or unisex full-length bib tights with a chamois.

categories.label: Base layers
categories.description: Men's or unisex cycling base layers, any sleeve length.

categories.label: Complete road bikes
categories.description: Complete road bikes (race, aero, endurance). Not gravel, not e-bikes, not framesets.

categories.label: Framesets
categories.description: Road framesets (frame and fork, sometimes with cockpit or seatpost).

categories.label: Carbon wheelsets
categories.description: Carbon road wheelsets, sold as a front-and-rear pair.

categories.label: Groupsets
categories.description: Complete road groupsets (shifters, derailleurs, brakes, crankset, cassette, chain), mechanical or electronic.

categories.label: Power meters
categories.description: Road power meters of any type (pedal, crank, spider); the dual-sided version if both are sold.

categories.label: Bike computers
categories.description: GPS bike computers, unit only (not bundles with sensors).

categories.label: Smart trainers
categories.description: Direct-drive or wheel-on smart trainers and smart bikes.
